proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for unifi-network-application, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the unifi-network-application service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the unifi-network-application
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  unifi-network-application:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.unifi-network-application.loadbalancer.server.port=8443
      - traefik.http.services.unifi-network-application.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https
      # The app serves a self-signed certificate: define a serversTransport with insecureSkipVerify: true
      # in Traefik's file provider (named insecure here) and reference it.
      - traefik.http.services.unifi-network-application.loadbalancer.serverstransport=insecure@file
      - traefik.http.routers.unifi-network-application.rule=Host(`unifi-network-application.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.unifi-network-application.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.unifi-network-application.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.unifi-network-application.service=unifi-network-application
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.unifi-network-application.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.unifi-network-application.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Unifi-network-application: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-unifi-network-application/blob/main/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: unifi-network-application-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: unifi-network-application
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
  MONGO_USER: unifi
  MONGO_PASS: ''
  MONGO_HOST: unifi-db
  MONGO_PORT: '27017'
  MONGO_DBNAME: unifi
  MONGO_AUTHSOURCE: admin
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: unifi-network-application-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: unifi-network-application
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: unifi-network-application
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: unifi-network-application
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: unifi-network-application
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: unifi-network-application
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: unifi-network-application
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/unifi-network-application:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: unifi-network-application-env
        ports:
        - name: port-8443
          containerPort: 8443
          protocol: TCP
        - name: port-3478
          containerPort: 3478
          protocol: UDP
        - name: port-10001
          containerPort: 10001
          protocol: UDP
        - name: port-8080
          containerPort: 8080
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: unifi-network-application-config
          mountPath: /config
      volumes:
      - name: unifi-network-application-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: unifi-network-application-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: unifi-network-application
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: unifi-network-application
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: unifi-network-application
  ports:
  - name: port-8443
    port: 8443
    targetPort: 8443
    protocol: TCP
  - name: port-3478
    port: 3478
    targetPort: 3478
    protocol: UDP
  - name: port-10001
    port: 10001
    targetPort: 10001
    protocol: UDP
  - name: port-8080
    port: 8080
    targetPort: 8080
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# unifi-network-application.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-unifi-network-application/blob/main/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Unifi-network-application (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/unifi-network-application:latest
ContainerName=unifi-network-application
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Environment=MONGO_USER=unifi
Environment=MONGO_PASS=
Environment=MONGO_HOST=unifi-db
Environment=MONGO_PORT=27017
Environment=MONGO_DBNAME=unifi
Environment=MONGO_AUTHSOURCE=admin
# Environment=MEM_LIMIT=1024
# Environment=MEM_STARTUP=1024
# Environment=MONGO_TLS=
Volume=/path/to/unifi-network-application/data:/config:Z
PublishPort=8443:8443
PublishPort=3478:3478/udp
PublishPort=10001:10001/udp
PublishPort=8080:8080
# PublishPort=1900:1900/udp
# PublishPort=8843:8843
# PublishPort=8880:8880
# PublishPort=6789:6789
# PublishPort=5514:5514/udp

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
